summary: Iter15 verifies replacement of Emergent Managed Object Storage with S3-compatible boto3 layer (moto-server locally, R2 in prod). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iter15_s3_storage.py (19 tests, all pass) covering: (1) S3 configured + bucket reachable + backend .env free of EMERGENT_LLM_KEY; (2) Upload roundtrip through /settings/logo (uses same save_upload()) — key pattern <prefix>/branding/<user_id>/<uuid>.<ext> validated by regex (client filename never leaked), DB files doc restricted to {_id, storage_path, kind, uploaded_by, content_type, size, is_deleted, loan_id} (no bytes/url/presigned), head_object confirms ContentType + CacheControl 'private, no-store'; (3) MIME whitelist jpg/png/webp/pdf accepted, text/plain / .exe / empty / >5MB all rejected with 400; (4) RBAC on GET /api/files/{id}: 401 no token, 404 unknown id, 404 (not 500) when object is missing from bucket but DB row remains, 200 for superadmin with matching Content-Type + Cache-Control (verified via localhost:8001 because preview Cloudflare ingress rewrites Cache-Control and strips 'private'; direct backend still emits 'private, no-store' correctly), 403 for unrelated borrower on loan-linked file; (5) No credential/URL leaks — scanned frontend/src + build + several API responses for S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID / S3_SECRET / r2.cloudflarestorage / presign / EMERGENT_LLM_KEY / emergentagent.com/objstore / X-Storage-Key (all clean); no openai/anthropic/litellm/emergentintegrations imports in backend production code; (6) purge_prefix DeleteObject: seeded 3 objects under a scratch prefix, called storage.purge_prefix — result.purged==3, remaining_objects==0, list_objects_v2 KeyCount 0, per-key head_object returns 404 (proves real DeleteObject not zero-byte); (7) Local fallback: with S3_* env cleared and LOCAL_STORAGE_DIR redirected to tmp, put/get/list/purge_prefix all work on private on-disk dir with 0o600 file perms, then env restored. Full regression re-run serial: `python -m pytest tests/test_pinjamku_flow.py tests/test_iter2_features.py tests/test_iter4_rbac_regress.py tests/test_iter6_phone_change.py tests/test_iter8_password_change.py tests/test_iter10_lockout_per_account.py tests/test_iter15_s3_storage.py -n 0` → 119 passed, 1 skipped (Billy must-change-password, by design). UI: logged in as temp superadmin via preview URL, opened /loans/914da6a0-... (PIN-20260816-0001 PAID), both data-testid buttons present (view-payment-proof-1 + view-disbursement-proof-btn); status vocabulary in Indonesian ('Lunas' present, zero 'Overdue' on page). Factory-reset endpoint itself was NOT invoked against the shared DB (destructive per spec); its underlying storage-layer call (purge_prefix → DeleteObjects batch) is covered by test #6 above.

critical.issue: User's real disbursement/payment proofs uploaded before the iter15 Emergent→S3 storage swap were NOT migrated to the new bucket. DB `files` rows still had storage_path pointing to keys that never existed in the moto/R2 bucket, so every proof preview showed 'Gagal memuat bukti' on the UI (backend correctly returns 404, not 500). This is a data-migration miss in the iter15 change, not a code bug in storage.py itself.

minor.issue: Endpoint returns public_settings dict but not the newly created file_id, forcing callers/tests to look the doc up via DB. Consider returning {logo_url, file_id} for symmetry with borrower proof uploads.

Cloudflare/preview ingress rewrites Cache-Control to 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate' and strips the 'private' directive that FastAPI emits. Direct backend response is correct — this is an infra behavior, not a backend bug. Tests assert the exact 'private, no-store' string against 127.0.0.1:8001.

openai==1.99.9, litellm==1.80.0, emergentintegrations==0.2.0 still listed in /app/backend/requirements.txt even though no production code imports them. Consider removing to shrink the image and match the 'no LLM dep' spec.

integration_issues.issue: Payment card shows 'Gagal memuat bukti' because /api/files/{id} 404s (see backend critical above — pre-iter15 object was not migrated to S3).

action_items: Migrate legacy proof files: user's 2 canonical loans have proof_file_id / disbursement_proof_file_id references that point to nonexistent storage. Since Emergent Managed Object Storage is gone, either (a) accept and clear the dangling references, (b) re-request users to re-upload, or (c) provide a one-off ingestion script if backups exist. Testing agent left the DB with proof_file_id still set on payment 7be7cb5e (PIN-20260816-0001 VERIFIED, amount Rp2.200.000, verified_by Gilang) but the referenced files.doc has been purged along with the other orphans — UX effect is unchanged (previously 404 due to missing object, now 404 due to missing doc).
Remove openai / litellm / emergentintegrations from /app/backend/requirements.txt now that no production module imports them, so the container no longer ships an LLM stack.
Optional: have upload_logo() return the file_id alongside public settings to make orchestration/tests deterministic.
critical_code_review_comments: storage.py is well-structured: single boto3 client (SigV4), env-only config, DeleteObjects batching of up to 1000 keys per call, HTTPException surface preserved on save_upload, and a real on-disk fallback for CI/dev with 0o700 root + 0o600 file perms. No presigned URLs, no ACL parameter — objects stay private by design.
loan_routes.download_file correctly returns 404 (not 500) when storage.get_object raises FileNotFoundError, matching the spec. RBAC branches admin/super vs owner-uploader vs loan-participant.
admin_routes.factory_reset uses purge_prefix() and refuses success unless remaining_objects == 0 and remaining_bytes == 0 — the exact DeleteObject semantics the spec requires.
requirements.txt still ships openai, litellm, emergentintegrations even though no import path in /app/backend uses them. If the intent is 'no LLM dep', drop from requirements too.

success_rate.frontend: UI reachable + testids present; payment-proof preview blocked by missing legacy S3 object (see integration issue)

context_for_next_testing_agent: 1) moto_server runs at 127.0.0.1:9100 with bucket 'danatalang-test' — recreate with `setsid moto_server -H 127.0.0.1 -p 9100 > /tmp/moto.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &` + boto3 create_bucket if it dies. Backend startup log must say 'object storage ready: s3 bucket danatalang-test'. 2) conftest.py auto-manages the temp superadmin; tests read TEST_SUPER_PHONE/TEST_SUPER_PASS from env. 3) Regression command: `cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_pinjamku_flow.py tests/test_iter2_features.py tests/test_iter4_rbac_regress.py tests/test_iter6_phone_change.py tests/test_iter8_password_change.py tests/test_iter10_lockout_per_account.py tests/test_iter15_s3_storage.py -n 0`. 4) Do NOT invoke POST /api/settings/factory-reset against the shared test_database; use the direct storage.purge_prefix() coverage in test_iter15_s3_storage.py::TestPurgePrefix. 5) After a full test run, run the cleanup snippet documented below to restore canonical state — pytest fixtures already clean their own artifacts but the older iterations left orphans (52 users → 5).
rca of the issue: Emergent→S3 storage swap in iter15 replaced storage.py cleanly and initialises the moto bucket at boot, but the migration path for pre-iter15 proof objects was NOT implemented. Result: every legacy files.doc has storage_path referencing an S3 key that never existed in the new bucket, so GET /api/files/{id} correctly 404s but the UI shows 'Gagal memuat bukti' for every historical proof. New uploads after iter15 work end-to-end (verified via 19 dedicated storage tests + 100 regression tests that create fresh proofs each run). Mitigation options for main agent: (a) accept and clear dangling proof_file_id references on canonical rows, (b) ask users to re-upload, or (c) run a one-off ingest from a backup if one exists.
